ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

4. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism.

   A. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.
